recs.x:
There is a really good video of OPSEC by grugq on YouTube from Hack In The Box Security Conference. Basically gives you some rules and things to think about, but also talks about where lulzsec went off the rails, and how they were caught. Really interesting talk.

recs.stt: DNS traffic can leak outside the VPN tunnel on Android
recs.x:
Edit: Other commenters report that Android will silently re-enable cell data under various conditions, so this isn't a surefire solution, either.

The Grugq created a tool for this a decade ago (sadly unmaintained): [link] as part of a presentation about operational security for hackers. It's a great watch if you're interested in how various (in)famous hackers thought they were secure and got busted anyway. [link]
